home.subheadline: Send money that stays completely hidden until the perfect moment. Birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day — make every gift unforgettable.
home.feature_escrow_desc: Funds are held in a Soroban smart contract — no one can touch them until the unlock date.
home.feature_stable_desc: Gifts are denominated in USDC so the amount never changes between sending and claiming.
home.feature_fees_desc: Stellar's high-speed network means more of your money reaches the recipient.
home.feature_ngn_desc: Pay in Naira via Paystack. Recipients can withdraw directly to their Nigerian bank account.
home.step1_desc: Enter the recipient's phone number, the amount in Naira, and choose a surprise unlock date.
home.step2_desc: Complete payment via Paystack or card. Funds are converted to USDC and locked on-chain.
home.step3_desc: They receive an SMS telling them a gift is waiting — but the amount stays hidden.
home.step4_desc: At the exact date and time you chose, the gift is revealed and the recipient can claim it.
